required_constraints.name: advisory_dataset_build_check2
required_constraints.definition: CHECK (build_generation = 1 AND predecessor_build_id IS NULL OR build_generation > 1 AND predecessor_build_id IS NOT NULL)

required_constraints.name: advisory_dataset_build_check3
required_constraints.definition: CHECK (checkpoint = 'REQUESTED'::text AND materialized_attempt_id IS NULL AND verified_attempt_id IS NULL OR (checkpoint = ANY (ARRAY['MATERIALIZED'::text, 'VERIFIED'::text, 'PROMOTED'::text, 'SEALED'::text])) AND materialized_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND materialize_receipt_hash IS NOT NULL AND materialized_file_set_hash IS NOT NULL)

required_constraints.name: advisory_dataset_build_check4
required_constraints.definition: CHECK ((checkpoint = ANY (ARRAY['REQUESTED'::text, 'MATERIALIZED'::text])) AND verified_attempt_id IS NULL AND verification_contract_version IS NULL OR (checkpoint = ANY (ARRAY['VERIFIED'::text, 'PROMOTED'::text, 'SEALED'::text])) AND verified_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND verify_receipt_hash IS NOT NULL AND verified_file_set_hash IS NOT NULL AND verification_contract_version IS NOT NULL)

required_constraints.name: advisory_dataset_build_check5
required_constraints.definition: CHECK ((checkpoint = ANY (ARRAY['REQUESTED'::text, 'MATERIALIZED'::text, 'VERIFIED'::text])) AND promoted_attempt_id IS NULL AND promotion_receipt_hash IS NULL AND promoted_manifest_hash IS NULL OR (checkpoint = ANY (ARRAY['PROMOTED'::text, 'SEALED'::text])) AND promoted_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND promotion_receipt_hash IS NOT NULL AND promoted_manifest_hash IS NOT NULL)

required_constraints.name: advisory_dataset_build_check6
required_constraints.definition: CHECK (checkpoint <> 'SEALED'::text AND sealed_attempt_id IS NULL AND seal_receipt_hash IS NULL AND sealed_snapshot_id IS NULL OR checkpoint = 'SEALED'::text AND sealed_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND seal_receipt_hash IS NOT NULL AND sealed_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL)

required_constraints.name: advisory_dataset_build_attempt_check1

required_constraints.name: advisory_outcome_label_payload_check1
required_constraints.definition: CHECK (terminal_disposition = 'NONE'::text AND terminal_symbol IS NULL AND terminal_event_trade_date IS NULL AND terminal_event_closed_at IS NULL AND terminal_source_hash IS NULL AND terminal_settlement_raw_li IS NULL AND terminal_settlement_adj_factor IS NULL AND terminal_settlement_quantity_multiplier IS NULL AND terminal_settlement_cashflow_yuan_per_share IS NULL AND censor_reason_code IS NULL OR terminal_disposition = 'RIGHT_CENSORED'::text AND terminal_symbol IS NOT NULL AND terminal_event_trade_date IS NOT NULL AND terminal_event_closed_at IS NOT NULL AND terminal_source_hash IS NOT NULL AND censor_reason_code IS NOT NULL AND terminal_settlement_raw_li IS NULL AND terminal_settlement_adj_factor IS NULL AND terminal_settlement_quantity_multiplier IS NULL AND terminal_settlement_cashflow_yuan_per_share IS NULL OR terminal_disposition = 'TERMINAL'::text AND terminal_symbol IS NOT NULL AND terminal_event_trade_date IS NOT NULL AND terminal_event_closed_at IS NOT NULL AND terminal_source_hash IS NOT NULL AND censor_reason_code IS NULL)
